name: Cloudi7 ID Card Generator
author: cloudi7

sections.description:
Cloudi7 ID Card Generator is a powerful yet simple plugin that allows you to create and manage professional-looking ID cards. Whether you need student IDs, employee badges, or membership cards, this plugin provides a clean interface to generate them quickly.

Key Features:

  • Complete Professional ID Cards: Includes Photo, QR Code, Signature, and Organizational details.
  • Double-Sided Support: Generates both front and back sides of the card.
  • Download as Image: High-quality download of front, back, or both sides as a single image.
  • Built-in Verification: Includes a verification system where users can scan the QR code to verify card authenticity.
  • Multiple Templates: Choose between Modern and Classic design skins.
  • Responsive Design: Cards look great and verify perfectly on mobile devices.
  • Organization Profile: Set your logo, address, and terms once to apply to all cards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cloudi7-id-card-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your organization settings in ‘ID Card Generator’ > ‘Settings’.
  4. Create your first card in ‘ID Card Generator’ > ‘Create New Card’.
  5. To enable verification, create a page with the shortcode: [cloudi7_icg_verify].
  6. Application form, create a page with the shortcode: ‘[cloudi7_icg_apply]’.
sections.faq:
How do I verify a card?

Every generated card has a unique ID and a QR code. When scanned, it leads to the verification page on your website (requires a page with the [cloudi7_icg_verify] shortcode).

Can I customize the colors?

The plugin currently supports ‘Modern’ and ‘Classic’ skins. Further customization can be done via CSS in your theme or the plugin’s CSS files.

  • Initial release.

  • Enhanced download functionality (Front, Back, Both).
  • Integrated local html2canvas for faster downloads.
  • Improved security and WordPress guideline compliance.
